architecture_name: Two-Stage KM-Weighted Incidence + Counterfactual Log-Time + Multi-GBDT + TabM PLE
architecture_summary: Decouples right-censored survival into incidence probability P(event=1|X) and counterfactual conditional log-time E[log(1+T)|X,event=1], blended with Optuna XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, and TabM-mini PLE under rank calibration.

assumptions.why_it_matters: Two-Stage incidence + counterfactual survival decomposition specifically models right-censored event indicators.
assumptions.if_violated_action: DIVERGE_DO_NOT_COPY survival decomposition; for uncensored regression/classification, use direct GBDT + TabM/RealMLP/Ridge.

assumptions.why_it_matters: StratifiedKFold + OOF target encoding assume equity/demographic strata overlap between train and test.
assumptions.if_violated_action: ADAPT: if groups are disjoint entities (GroupKFold), exclude group IDs from features and use entity-grouped inner validation.

divergent_options.hypothesis: Predict raw efs_time directly without censoring decomposition.
divergent_options.rationale: Treats censored survivors identically to early deaths; severe concordance collapse.

divergent_options.hypothesis: Train LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost on Kaplan-Meier transformed survival target.
divergent_options.rationale: Strong diverse base learners (+0.0735 C_INDEX), retained inside multi-stream ensemble alongside Two-Stage Counterfactual.

divergent_options.hypothesis: Fuse Two-Stage Counterfactual GBDT (0.68574) + Optuna XGB/LGBM/CatBoost + TabM PLE + rank_calibration_blend on all 28,800 rows.
divergent_options.rationale: Outperformed every solo survival branch with +0.00761 gain over prior 0.67940 commit and 0.0 zero-pickle parity.

convergence_rationale: Two-Stage Counterfactual decoupling captures both event incidence and conditional timing; ensembling with KM-target GBDTs and TabM PLE maximizes stratified concordance across demographic cohorts.
copy_vs_adapt_rules: DO NOT copy Two-Stage survival decomposition onto uncensored datasets lacking an event indicator.
ALWAYS verify whether group columns are overlapping strata (keep as features) or disjoint entity IDs (exclude under GroupKFold).
